name: home-nvr
description: Nền tảng quản lý camera gia đình tự lưu trữ

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @home-nvr/contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web "npm run dev -w @home-nvr/contracts" "npm run dev -w @home-nvr/api" "npm run dev -w @home-nvr/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @home-nvr/contracts && npm run build -w @home-nvr/api && npm run build -w @home-nvr/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @home-nvr/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build -w @home-nvr/contracts && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx apps/api/src/migrate.ts
scripts.pack:release: npm run build && npm run sync:release-lock && npm pack --ignore-scripts
